summary: The single typed task60 command, producer, completion and lower-read owner.

rows.shim: xm1_loading_configuration, xm1_loading_startup, xm1_loading_ready, xm1_loading_legacy_request, xm1_loading_legacy_cancel, xm1_loading_configure, xm1_loading_absolute_deadline, xm1_loading_initialize, xm1_loading_request, xm1_loading_request_sync, xm1_loading_cancel, xm1_loading_wait_channel and xm1_loading_observe_completion
rows.other_side: startup construction, stock task60 wrapper callers and Develop loading callers
rows.removal: all callers use the Rust API in one final composition

evidence.requirement: The Root bank publishes the startup/request/cancel veneers at 0x73ac74/0x73ac94/0x73aca4 only when it links all three owner bodies. The composition supplies one schema1 policy; each legacy request forms one finite absolute deadline through that provider and carries it unchanged through read and cleanup. No duration, default or cleanup budget is fitted by the library. Abort argument 0x91482c remains a task argument, not policy storage.

rows.shim: task60 queue, task, wait, signal and current-task leaves
rows.other_side: retained RTOS message and semaphore services
rows.removal: the kernel owns typed queue and wait APIs

evidence.requirement: Queue60 retains the source 48-byte capacity and 16-message depth. The 24-byte envelope carries the request's original absolute deadline. The receiver supplies its own 24-byte payload buffer, and task startup preserves the nine reserved completion semaphores and task-id publication.

rows.shim: NAND, decoder, segment, extent, progress and delegated-command leaves
rows.other_side: retained X-M1 services; the owned image5 decoder and NAND owner are called directly in the same bank
rows.removal: the corresponding device and delegated command units are owned

evidence.requirement: The DMA unit is fixed at 0x20000 bytes. Plain backing is 0x360000 bytes and image5 staging is 0x2e0000 bytes; 0x100000 remains a controller budget, not a lease extent. The plain progress reporter is the source-inspected void ABI at 0x73b924.
